1. For each pixel and channel, compute the mean count I P / 255.
2. Draw a Poisson count from uniform numbers that depend only on the seed, the position and the channel.
3. Means below 10 use the multiplication method of Knuth. Larger means use the PTRS method of Hörmann.
4. Scale the count back by 255 / P, clip to 0 to 255 and round.
